title: an Error reference to an error enum value may be thrown
purpose: Observe failure, cleanup and lifetime ordering during execution.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 9.5.1, 12.1: an error enum value converts to Error; throwing that reference keeps the enum value, so a typed catch of the enum matches. Error text follows spec 9.5.1 (generated Type.case(payload)).
